page.title: New Developments & Off-Plan Projects
page.description: Discover how our digital infrastructure connects developers directly with active real estate agents. Learn how developers can deploy their new build projects to the grid completely free of charge, and how agents gain instant access to a shareable portfolio of off-plan properties to accelerate their sales.
page.body:
New Developments: Connecting Developers and Agents
The New Developments section operates as a dedicated hub within the PropertyList infrastructure, giving agents direct access to active and upcoming property projects listed directly by developers. We ensure that project information is accurate, up to date, and straight from the source.

Free Access for Estate Agents

Looking for high-quality new-build properties to offer your clients? At PropertyList, verified agents get completely free access to a growing portfolio of new developments from trusted developers across Spain.

See all New Developments here

Inside this strategic section, you can:

Centralised Browsing: Browse all available new development projects in one unified place.
Comprehensive Data: View detailed project information including digital brochures, floor plans, price lists, high-resolution media, and exact specifications.
Transparent Financials: Clearly see the sales commission percentages and the exact payment structure offered by the developer.
Unit-Level Tracking: See unit-level availability and precise pricing where provided.
CRM Integration: Register buyer interest, track enquiries, and add specific units directly to your Smart CRM to manage them within your automated sales pipeline.
Instant Distribution: Share development listings directly with your clients using ready-to-share digital assets.
Whether you are working with investors, relocators, or first-time buyers, PropertyList gives you the tools to present opportunities professionally and close deals efficiently. Save time - no need to chase developers or request marketing materials. Everything is in one place, ready to go.

Developers: List for Free Forever
Are you a property developer looking to showcase your new-build projects to a wider audience at zero cost? PropertyList is your opportunity to get direct exposure to active deal makers without any listing fees.

Why List on PropertyList?

100% Free to List: There are no hidden charges and no expensive subscription plans. Simply upload your developments to the grid and start generating immediate interest.
Access to Active Agents: Your properties become instantly searchable and shareable by a vast network of local and international estate agents who are actively working with direct clients.
No Middlemen: Agents can send your properties directly to their buyers, significantly boosting your visibility and increasing the chances of a quicker sale.
Easy to Onboard: We support various data feeds to help get your listings live and synced with the infrastructure fast.
Pay Only on Results: You only pay your agreed commission once a minimum 10% deposit has been received and cleared. There are no upfront costs and zero risk to your marketing budget.
Highlight Developments (Premium): When you need to accelerate sales, you can optionally deploy credits to highlight your projects - making them stand out with enhanced visibility on the homepage and in network newsletters.
Designed to help you sell faster, PropertyList amplifies your reach whether you are launching a brand-new phase or strategically selling your final remaining units. Start listing today - it is free, fast, and built to accelerate your business.



👉 Start exploring new developments today and match your clients with the perfect property.
